kane.creditCapNote: 80 is an operating ceiling enforced BETWEEN calls: a successful kane-cli balance check is required before each call, a call is refused if the remaining budget is below its conservative estimate (objective 40, analyzer 15; V1 analyzer calls measured 5.4-6.5), and no call starts once measured spending reaches 80. A running kane-cli call cannot be stopped at a credit limit, so one call can overshoot; objective calls are additionally bounded by maxSteps and timeoutS.
